newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLA SEES LIQUIDITY IN SHR CONVERSION.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA SEES LIQUIDITY IN SHR CONVERSION.

text.p: Finnish insurer Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola -- to be renamed Pohjola-Yhtyma -- said in a statment on Thursday it would allow conversion of A shares into B shares to create better liquidity.
"The Articles of Association of Pohjola-Yhtyma will include a provision to the effect that A-shares can be changed into B-shares," it said in a statement on broader restructuring.
"The right to change A-shares into B-shares will create conditions for a further improvement of the liquidity of the shares," it added.
